assign_user_roles.description: Give a user one or more roles. Assigning a role they already hold changes nothing, so this is safe to re-run.

parameters.description: The user's Auth0 id, like auth0|68f0c1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0 - including the vertical bar. Use List users or Find users by email to get one.

create_password_change_ticket.description: Mint a one-time URL that lets a user set a new password. Anyone holding the link can use it, so treat it as a credential.
create_password_change_ticket.display_str_template: Create an Auth0 password reset link for user {0}.
create_password_change_ticket.name: create_password_change_ticket

parameters.description: The user's Auth0 id, like auth0|68f0c1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0 - including the vertical bar. Use List users or Find users by email to get one.
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: Where to send the user once they have set their password. Leave empty to show Auth0's own confirmation.
parameters.name: result_url

parameters.description: How long the link works, in seconds. Auth0's default is 432000 - five days. The most allowed here is 2592000 (30 days).
parameters.name: ttl_sec

parameters.description: Turn on to treat using the link as proof the user owns the address.
parameters.name: mark_email_as_verified

create_password_change_ticket.result_str_template: Created an Auth0 password reset link.

create_role.description: Create a role the tenant's users can be given. Permissions are added to it in the Auth0 dashboard.

create_user.description: Create a user in one of the tenant's database connections, with an email address and a password.
create_user.name: create_user

parameters.description: The address the user signs in with.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: The user's initial password. It has to satisfy the tenant's password policy - by default at least 8 characters with a mix of cases, numbers and symbols - and Auth0 rejects one that appears in a known breach.
parameters.name: password

parameters.description: Which database connection the user belongs in. Leave empty if the tenant has only one - Lodol will find it. Most tenants call theirs Username-Password-Authentication.
parameters.name: connection

parameters.description: A username, if the connection is set up to require one. Most are not - leave it empty unless yours is.
parameters.name: username

parameters.description: The user's first name.
parameters.name: given_name

parameters.description: The user's last name.
parameters.name: family_name

parameters.description: The name shown for this user in Auth0.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: A short name for the user.
parameters.name: nickname

parameters.description: Mark the address as verified without the user clicking anything. Only turn this on for an address you already trust.
parameters.name: email_verified

parameters.description: Turn on to have Auth0 email the user a verification link as soon as they are created.
parameters.name: verify_email

parameters.description: Turn on to stop this user signing in, without deleting them.
parameters.name: blocked

parameters.description: Data the user is allowed to change, as a JSON object - for example {"theme": "dark"}. Auth0 merges this into whatever is already there rather than replacing it, and only at the top level.
parameters.name: user_metadata

parameters.description: Data only your applications can change, as a JSON object - for example {"plan": "pro"}. Merged the same way as user metadata.
